definitions.explanation: Moving, acting, or responding slowly. Often carries a slightly negative or impatient connotation, implying annoyance at the slowness.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧のろい。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のろい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He's slow at work, so he's always working overtime.

examples.japanese: のろい⟦{足取|あしど}り→足取り：10625_ashidori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧。
examples.english: I was walking at a sluggish pace and missed the train.

notes:
USAGE:
An i-adjective with a somewhat negative, critical tone. More colloquial and blunter than ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧. Can describe speed of movement, work pace, or mental quickness.

FORMS:
- のろい (dictionary form)
- のろく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (negative)
- のろかった (past)
- のろく⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (adverbial: to walk slowly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: slow, late — neutral, standard term
- のろい: slow, sluggish — more informal and critical
- とろい: sluggish, dim-witted — colloquial, often about mental slowness
- ⟦のろのろ→のろのろ：05162_noronoro⟧: sluggishly (onomatopoeia) — describes slow, plodding movement
